name: Lethal Ape V2
summary: Lethal Ape 2 is a suspense-filled survival horror game that immerses you in the aftermath of a secret experiment gone horribly wrong. Trapped inside a decrepit research facility, you must evade a bloodthirsty, mutated ape that was once part of a classified military project. With each creaking floorboard and flickering light, the terror grows. Scavenge for supplies, uncover disturbing files, and solve cryptic puzzles to piece together what happened.
